record Box(n: number)
const Values: Box[] = [Box(n: 19), Box(n: 43)]
const First: Box[] = for item in @Values { Box(n: @item.n + 2) }
const Second: Box[] = for item in @First { Box(n: @item.n + 3) }
const X: number = @Second[0].n
const Y: number = @Second[1].n

record Shape(p: path, n: number)
module Make(x: number, n: number) {
 const P: path = segment(start: (1, 2), end: (@x + 1, 2))
 const Values: Shape[] = [Shape(p: @P, n: @n)]
 const Mapped: Shape[] = for item in @Values { Shape(p: @item.p, n: @item.n + 2) }
 export const out: Shape = @Mapped[0]
}
instance One = Make(x: 11, n: 19)
instance Two = Make(x: 29, n: 43)
const P: path = @One::out.p
const Q: path = @Two::out.p
const L: number = @P.length
const M: number = @Q.length
const X: number = @P.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Q.endPoint.x
const N: number = @One::out.n
const O: number = @Two::out.n
